ideas.name: first half-hour predicts the last
ideas.why: Gao, Han, Li & Zhou (2018): the first 30 minutes' return predicts the last 30 minutes' (late informed trading, hedging into the close)

ideas.name: same half-hour, last 20 days
ideas.why: recurring flows (fixings, hedges, rebalances) arrive at the same clock time each day, so a half-hour's usual direction repeats

ideas.name: any box warning against VWAP slope
ideas.why: confirmed #1 on the 1m EMA row and the same lean on the 5m rows: pooled over every row, warnings against VWAP's slope (derived from our own results, so it must pass both stages afresh)

ideas.name: flip1 with the weekly bias
ideas.why: price above last week's close is the week's buyers in control; flips with them carry

ideas.name: flip1 with the Globex-open bias
ideas.why: price above the 17:00 open means the full session's net flow is up; flips with it carry
